item.title: USSF expands Space Domain Awareness Accelerator through Texas Space Commission grant to UT Austin
item.description: The Texas Space Commission (TSC), in partnership with U.S. Space Force (USSF), will significantly expand the USSF Space Domain Awareness (SDA) Tools, Applications, and Processing (TAP) Lab delivering continued integration of emerging technologies to outpace sophisticated adversaries, bolster the USSF’s mission readiness, and guarantee the delivery of vital space capabilities to the Joint Force.

item.title: The Four Chaplains: A foundation of spiritual fitness
item.description: Every year on the anniversary of the sinking, ceremonies and prayer services are held throughout the military to honor the legacy and sacrifice of the Four Chaplains. For members of the Chaplain Corps though, their story is more than just an annual reminder.

item.title: Language exchange event strengthens bond between Camp Zama volunteers, Japanese youth
item.description: Thirteen Soldier, civilian and family member volunteers from Camp Zama, Japan, listened to and spoke with a group of junior high- and high school-aged students from Camp Zama’s neighboring city of Zama during a language exchange event Feb. 22 at Zama City Hall.

item.title: Iron Fist 26, Strengthening U.S. Marine and Japan Forces Combined Amphibious Capabilities
item.description: CAMP HANSEN, Japan – U.S. Marines and sailors with the 3rd Marine Expeditionary Brigade and the 31st Marine Expeditionary Unit joined members of the Japan Ground Self-Defense Force for the opening ceremony of Exercise Iron Fist 26 on Feb. 23, 2026.

item.title: Nevis, U.S. Dental Providers partner during LAMAT 2026
item.description: As part of Lesser Antilles Medical Assistance Team (LAMAT) 2026, U.S. Air Force Reserve dental personnel are working alongside their Nevician counterparts to deliver essential dental care while strengthening relationships across the Caribbean. LAMAT, a health security cooperation engagement, enhances regional medical collaboration and professional integration among healthcare providers across Caribbean nations. item.title: Sticks up, borders down: International lacrosse in Okinawa
item.description: During the sixth annual Lacrosse Okinawa Open held Feb. 19-21, 2026, at Shintoshin Park, Japan, teams representing 17 Southeast Asian countries converged for three days of fast-paced international competition.

item.title: Army Engineers, Marines cut ribbon on new expeditionary dining facility in Pohang, South Korea
item.description: Col. William Doctor, Camp Mujuk commander; Lt. Col. Robert Howell, U.S. Army Corps of Engineers – Far East District deputy commander; the Republic of Korea Ministry of National Defense – Defense Installations Agency (MND-DIA), and members of the project team gathered to cut the ribbon on an Expeditionary Dining Facility, Camp Mujuk, South Korea, on Feb. 23, 2026.

item.title: Exercise Cobra Gold 2026 Opening Ceremony
item.description: RAYONG PROVINCE, Thailand – Service members from the United States, Thailand, and partners from 30 countries gathered for the opening ceremony of the 45th iteration of Exercise Cobra Gold in Rayong Province, Kingdom of Thailand, Feb. 24, 2026. Exercise Cobra Gold was established as a bilateral maritime exercise between the United States and Thailand. item.description: 7th Fleet's OEPC play for the Shinnenkai Reception for the CNFJ Holiday Party at the New Sanno Hotel in Tokyo.
